study.question: Does an explicit target-match by coarse-history-order value moment add useful click ranking information beyond the incumbent separate match/local-order/coarse-linear/quadratic summaries, at matched added capacity and operator count?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: the inspected incumbent concatenates four separately pooled moments before a nonlinear task adapter; it does not expose the value moment of within-block centered target affinity multiplied by block rank. Nonlinear readout of marginal moments cannot in general reconstruct this joint moment. Earlier ordered block and curvature improvements motivate testing this representational uncertainty; they do not establish that this missing direction is predictive. Residualizing the product against match and local ordinal coefficients may retain target-relevant chronological variation discarded by the compression. Ordered residual should outperform scrambled-order and duplicate channels with the same architecture. This is an explicit interaction test, not a claim that target-aware temporal modeling is new.

nearest_work.difference: Archived DIN primary text establishes target-conditioned local activation and pooling. Retain the adapted action-aware scorer; add a fixed masked cross-moment before task-specific residual readout. No original DIN reproduction or priority claim.

Pinned forward lines175-200 flatten the sequence with context for unified tokenization. Our fifth channel is an explicit low-dimensional target-match/order contraction and retains the thirty compressed slots; no flattened learned tokenizer or paired-stream mixing is imported. Original paper not audited; novelty unverified.

Pinned forward lines119-156 preserve sequence tokens and iterate a masked unified interaction stack. Our operator is a single fixed masked residual moment feeding existing task adapters. Original paper not audited; no equivalence or priority claim.

Pinned HeMix forward129-187 and tokenizer215-237 split recent/earlier histories and query them with feature-conditioned and fixed tokens. Our proposal retains the existing ten-block compression and task bank, adding one explicit residualized exact-match/ordinal product rather than learned query attention or token mixing. Its target/temporal theme is prior work; originality of the specific fixed-moment form is unverified. Original paper text unavailable; explicit UniRank section2.3 fallback read.

inherited_components: FeatureEmbeddingDict and shared target/history tables; action-aware DIN scorer and Dice towers

study.proposed_difference: Append one value-width channel to each adapter input (+4*16*112=7168 dense parameters at frozen schema). Let a be per-event mean of valid item/category/brand exact-match flags, centered within each ten-event block. Let p be within-block centered ordinal and r the coarse block rank. Build a*r and a*fixed-scrambled-r. Project both products twice off the span of p and a (Gram-Schmidt basis), with within-block recentering, in FP32. The resulting directions are also orthogonal to block-constant linear/quadratic channels because they have zero sum within each block. A common gate requires both interaction directions, match norm, local norm and the inherited fourth coefficient to be nondegenerate. Scale each interaction, duplicate a and duplicate quadratic to the same local-ordinal coefficient L2 norm, with the same common gate. Contract five channels against the same masked values and sqrt(valid_count) denominator in every variant. Only the selected fifth coefficient differs. The common gate itself is target/order dependent and is shared by controls; duplicate controls test added direction beyond that shared gate, not strictly absence of any new information. No supplied masks or labels are modified.
predictions: Primary predeclared contrast: joint_ordered full validation click AUC exceeds joint_scrambled and both duplicate controls, and exceeds g0-r0014-curvature_task. A gain over the weaker frozen sources alone is insufficient.

Predicted largest exploratory benefit is in history_gt64, where several blocks and match variation can support the interaction. Existing bins and counts are retained; no slice-based selection or significance claim. Empty and unsupported histories have exactly zero fifth coefficient.

All four new variants have equal parameter counts, summary tensor shapes and operator construction. Expected total32129765, embedding31793216, dense336549; host counts required. Forward predictions initially match the source because final adapter layers are zero, despite changed adapter input width.

Runtime should remain near the measured parent332.58s (train300.64s), but new FP32 projections and fifth channel add work. Predeclared practical frontier: at most1.20x parent wall/model latency for a positive primary contrast; report actual throughput, memory and quality/cost rather than infer equality from operator counts.
Report all auxiliary AUC/Logloss and mean separately. Parent cart/fav/buy AUC0.766562/0.780520/0.745301 versus DIN0.849070/0.864897/0.870182 is a material existing tradeoff, not multi-task dominance.
falsifiers: If joint_ordered fails to exceed the incumbent or either matched duplicate, useful added joint direction is unsupported for this implementation.
If joint_scrambled matches/exceeds ordered, chronological interpretation is unsupported even if generic extra direction helps.

If support is negligible, projections unstable under BF16 contraction, padding affects predictions, auxiliary item/scorer gradients leak or finite backward checks fail, execution is inadmissible pending correction; that is an implementation failure, not scientific refutation.

If any advantage disappears in later paired seeds or is explained by measured runtime/capacity controls, retain the original outcome and downgrade the explanation. Single seed and adaptive validation selection cannot establish repeated support.
Improved click AUC accompanied by degraded auxiliary scores must be reported as a task tradeoff; it cannot establish uniform four-task improvement.
alternative_explanations: Extra adapter capacity or changed first-layer initialization from widening, controlled within the four new cells but confounded versus archived incumbent.
Support gate introduces new availability information shared by all cells; sparse support can obscure the hypothesized direction.
Residual coefficient normalization changes conditioning; equal norms do not imply equal activation/gradient distributions or actual GPU cost.
Fixed scrambled rank is one deterministic alternative, not an exhaustive permutation null.
Repeated adaptive search and one training seed may exploit validation noise; archived same-seed arms are not independent replications.
Released delayed feedback and whole-window vocab/static features limit conclusions to the offline benchmark.
Null earlier task scorers and interaction channels show that adding task conditioning or interactions need not help; new cross-moment may also fail.

import math, random
rng=random.Random(20261106)
def dot(x,y): return sum(a*b for a,b in zip(x,y))
def norm(x): return dot(x,x)
def scale(x,a): return [v*a for v in x]
def center(x,m):
 y=[]
 for g in range(10):
  lo=g*10; n=sum(m[lo:lo+10]); mu=sum(x[i]*m[i] for i in range(lo,lo+10))/max(n,1)
  y.extend(m[i]*(x[i]-mu) for i in range(lo,lo+10))
 return y
def remove(x,b):
 s=dot(x,b)/max(norm(b),1e-10)
 return [v-s*w for v,w in zip(x,b)]
def coarse(raw,linear,m):
 n=max(sum(m),1); mu=dot(raw,m)/n
 x=[v*(r-mu) for v,r in zip(m,raw)]
 s=dot(x,linear)/max(norm(linear),1e-12)
 x=[v*(r-s*l) for v,r,l in zip(m,x,linear)]
 mu=sum(x)/n
 return [v*(r-mu) for v,r in zip(m,x)]
def coeff(m,a):
 a=center(a,m); p=center([(i%10)/9 for i in range(100)],m)
 r=[(i//10)/9 for i in range(100)]
 sr=[[0,7,2,9,4,1,8,3,6,5][i//10]/9 for i in range(100)]
 n=max(sum(m),1); rm=dot(r,m)/n
 linear=[v*(rank-rm) for v,rank in zip(m,r)]
 q=coarse([(x-rm)**2 for x in r],linear,m)
 sq=coarse([x*x for x in sr],linear,m)
 occupied=sum(any(m[g*10:g*10+10]) for g in range(10))
 support=occupied>=3 and norm(q)>1e-10 and norm(sq)>1e-10
 block=scale(linear,math.sqrt(norm(p)/max(norm(linear),1e-12)) if norm(linear)>1e-12 else 0)
 q=scale(q,math.sqrt(norm(block)/max(norm(q),1e-10)) if support else 0)
 basis=a[:]
 for _ in range(2): basis=center(remove(basis,p),m)
 if norm(basis)<=1e-10: basis=[0.]*100
 def residual(rank):
  x=center([v*z for v,z in zip(a,rank)],m)
  for _ in range(2): x=center(remove(remove(x,p),basis),m)
  return x
 ordered,scrambled=residual(r),residual(sr)
 gate=all(norm(x)>1e-10 for x in (ordered,scrambled,p,a,q))
 target=norm(p)
 modes=[scale(x,math.sqrt(target/max(norm(x),1e-10)) if gate else 0) for x in (ordered,scrambled,a,q)]
 return modes,(a,p,block,q),gate
cases=[]
for n in range(101): cases.append(([int(i>=100-n) for i in range(100)],[rng.randrange(4)/3 for _ in range(100)]))
for bits in range(1024):
 m=[1]*100
 m[40:50]=[(bits>>i)&1 for i in range(10)]
 cases.append((m,[rng.randrange(4)/3 for _ in range(100)]))
for _ in range(2000):
 density=rng.choice([.02,.15,.5,.8,1.])
 m=[int(rng.random()<density) for _ in range(100)]
 a=[rng.randrange(4)/3 for _ in range(100)]
 cases.append((m,a))
# Explicit missing matches, uniform affinity, singleton blocks and collinear bases.
for n in range(101):
 m=[int(i>=100-n) for i in range(100)]
 for a in ([0.]*100,[1.]*100,[(i%10)/9 for i in range(100)]): cases.append((m,a))
cases.append(([int(i%10==9) for i in range(100)],[i%4/3 for i in range(100)]))
supported=0; witness=None; max_leak=0.
for m,a in cases:
 modes,old,gate=coeff(m,a)
 norms=[norm(x) for x in modes]
 assert all(math.isfinite(v) for x in modes for v in x)
 assert all(x[i]==0. for x in modes for i in range(100) if not m[i])
 assert max(norms)-min(norms)<1e-8
 if gate:
  supported+=1
  assert abs(norms[0]-norm(old[1]))<1e-8
 else: assert norms==[0.]*4
 for x in modes[:2]:
  for g in range(10): assert abs(sum(x[g*10:g*10+10]))<1e-8
  for b in old:
   err=abs(dot(x,b)); max_leak=max(max_leak,err)
   assert err<1e-8
 if gate and witness is None:
  # A linear-map witness, not an observed pair of real benchmark records.
  # Values 0 versus ordered coefficients have identical four old summaries
  # and per-block means, but the fifth moment differs by ||ordered||^2.
  x=modes[0]
  assert norm(x)>0
  assert all(abs(dot(x,b))<1e-8 for b in old)
  witness=norm(x)/math.sqrt(max(sum(m),1))
 # Coefficients cannot depend on values in padding, including adversarial fill.
 values=[rng.random() if v else 1e9 for v in m]
 changed=[z if v else -1e9 for z,v in zip(values,m)]
 assert all(dot(x,values)==dot(x,changed) for x in modes)
assert supported>0 and witness is not None
print(json.dumps({'scalar_specification_cases':len(cases),'synthetic_supported_cases':supported,'maximum_old_direction_dot_error':max_leak,'linear_map_witness_fifth_change':witness,'scope':'Python scalar specification only; no torch, FP32/BF16, real data prevalence, gradients or performance validation'},sort_keys=True))
